summary: The pending authentication debounce is cancellable, and the empty-token path cancels it before starting local authentication. The focused test covers this scenario.

evidence: static/chat.js adds debounce.cancel() and invokes scheduleAuthCheck.cancel() in the empty-token branch at lines 50-63 and 597-604.
tests/chat-auth-debounce.test.ts creates a pending auth debounce, dispatches an empty-token input, verifies cancellation, and confirms the local-auth badge remains successful at lines 147-161.
